hooks.name: Component test scaffold reminder
hooks.description: When a new React component is created in the components directory, remind to create a co-located test file

action.prompt: A new React component file has been created. Consider: 1) Creating a co-located test file (*.test.tsx) for this component. 2) Ensure the component uses proper accessibility attributes (aria-labels, roles). 3) If this is a reusable UI component, export it from the components barrel file.
